profile.name: Ansh Vishwakarma
profile.tagline: Full-Stack Developer & Founder building production-grade web applications end to end.
profile.specialization: Full-Stack Development · AI Applications · Data & Network Analytics
profile.bio: I build and deploy production-grade web applications from wireframes to deployment, while helping businesses turn ideas into scalable digital products. As the Founder & Lead Full-Stack Engineer at OREN, I have delivered 6+ live projects and managed 5+ client engagements across domestic and international clients.

experience.summary: Building production web solutions for businesses while owning the complete product lifecycle from discovery and wireframes to deployment.
highlights: Built and deployed 3+ production Next.js/React websites for Cape Town hospitality clients with custom booking and menu flows.
Cut client time-to-market by approximately 40% through streamlined development and deployment workflows.
Owned wireframing, CRM integration, deployment and product delivery, contributing to approximately 30% higher client lead conversion.

experience.summary: Working on networking fundamentals, network performance monitoring and analytics using Python and Power BI.
highlights: Configured wireless routers and IPv4/IPv6 subnet schemes.
Built Python and Power BI dashboards tracking latency, throughput and packet loss.
Applied network-performance metrics to identify and analyze potential degradation.

experience.summary: Worked on cybersecurity labs, vulnerability assessment and secure software-development practices.
highlights: Performed vulnerability assessments and threat-detection laboratory exercises.
Applied secure-coding practices during cybersecurity tasks.

experience.summary: Connected students with technology and career opportunities through outreach, webinars and relationship management.
highlights: Achieved 15 student registrations within two days through direct outreach.
Organized 3+ webinars connecting students with industry mentors.

experience.summary: Selected for a three-month internship focused on frontend, backend, databases, APIs and complete software development workflows.
highlights: Completed and submitted portfolio, learning-management and e-commerce analytics projects.
Worked across responsive UI, component architecture, application workflows and data visualization.

experience.summary: Completed an internship focused on scalable web applications, digital service platforms and user-centered delivery.
highlights: Built practical experience in application development, optimization and maintenance.
Strengthened professional discipline, problem solving and collaborative delivery habits.

experience.summary: Developed practical exposure to threat analysis, vulnerability assessment and incident response through guided cybersecurity work.
highlights: Practiced identifying security risks and analyzing potential incidents.
Worked with mentors on real-world cybersecurity scenarios and secure practices.
